scope_gaps.note: The sources speak of people in psychological crisis or needing specialist help; none speaks of a persistent lowering of mood or says when to seek support.
The condition (mood that makes daily life harder) is the editors' threshold; the sources do not define when professional contact is advised.
The snapshots are dated 05.12.2024 (Ministry of Health) and 29.07.2025 (Ministry of Digital Affairs); the sentence gives no date, and opening hours and funding were stated for those dates.
The source says nagłej sytuacji zagrożenia życia lub zdrowia; the sentence says bezpośrednim zagrożeniu. Treated as the same condition.
No snapshot defines severity of symptoms or suicidal risk, and none says what kind of assessment is required.
Scope of the review (population, interventions, comparators, outcome) cannot be assessed without the blocked BMJ article.
Which forms of exercise reduced symptoms, against which active controls and on which measure cannot be assessed without the blocked BMJ article.
The sentence says exercise can complement treatment; whether the review studied exercise added to treatment or instead of it cannot be assessed without the blocked BMJ article.

notes: The cited BMJ article (https://www.bmj.com/content/384/bmj-2023-075847) was blocked (HTTP 403) and has no snapshot, so every row that depends on it (title#1.2, W praktyce#3, Korzyść i dowody#1-3, Ocena dowodów#1.1) is source_unavailable. The two gov.pl snapshots are the Ministry of Health page of 05.12.2024 (f231cd969d441cef.txt, main region only: keptChars 4636 of wholeChars 8637) and the Ministry of Digital Affairs news item of 29.07.2025 (601d0f7b15c908cb.txt, whole document); both are real pages with enough text. Classification choices: W praktyce#3 is filed as a source_claim (what exercise can do next to treatment), not as a derived recommendation. W praktyce#2 is filed as a meta_statement (what the item does not demand of the reader); no snapshot speaks of exercise as a condition of help. Ograniczenia#2 and #3 are filed as derived recommendations with partly verdicts. The grade letter A in Ocena dowodów was not checked because it is editorial.
